clauses.finding: pRetry owns attemptNumber, retriesConsumed and startTime; onAttemptFailure checks elapsed time and retry allowance. The caller input is separate. maxRetryTime is not a timer that preempts an in-flight input.
Input is awaited with attemptNumber; success checks signal then returns value; caught failure is delegated to the failure controller.

AbortError bypasses hooks. Already exhausted time calls only onFailedAttempt then rejects. Otherwise shouldConsumeRetry precedes onFailedAttempt; time/count/non-network TypeError checks precede shouldRetry. Non-consuming allowed retries skip delay and do not increment retriesConsumed, but remain subject to time and retriesLeft checks.
Retry-count/time exhaustion, non-network TypeError and shouldRetry=false reject. All requested stop paths are real.

AbortError unwraps originalError. Signal abort clears/rejects the delay and is checked at controller checkpoints. Input receives attemptNumber only and is directly awaited; pRetry does not itself interrupt it. Input may cooperate with a signal independently.
Backoff is capped by configured maxTimeout and remaining maxRetryTime; both time limits can be Infinity. Timer/delay and loop are real. Excluded makeRetriable wrapper exists.
Evidence and useful views/cards without count targets are deliverable rules, not repository behavior requiring a fake source citation.

clauses.finding: QuickLRU owns two in-memory Maps, current generation count, capacity, default expiry and callback. No persistent or remote storage is implied by source.

Current-key set replaces without count increment. A key absent from current is inserted even if present in old. At threshold, callbacks cover the whole discarded old generation, current becomes old, and a new current map/count begins. get promotion also uses the same insertion helper and can rotate.

Current get uses the expiry-truthiness gated helper. Old get checks expiration directly, promotes only unexpired entries and returns value; missing falls through to undefined. Expiry invokes callback then delete, which affects both maps.
has and peek do not promote but can delete expired entries. has directly checks expiry; peek shares the value helper's expiry truthiness gate. Missing returns false or undefined respectively.

Expiry and rotation invoke optional onEviction. Manual delete removes both-map occurrences and decrements count only if current held the key; clear empties both and resets count. Neither manual method invokes eviction callbacks.

Iteration, resize and exact public size arithmetic are valid explicit exclusions. The nonexistent constructor-seeded feature exclusion has been removed. The listed core lifecycle methods define scope; evidence/views/card rules are deliverable requirements.

recommendations.replacement: Replace inserting a new key with inserting a key absent from the current generation, including a key still present in the old generation. State that get promotion can trigger rotation through the same insertion helper.
recommendations.reason: new could mean globally absent; the actual branch is current-map membership.
recommendations.status: resolved by revised visible task wording; no additional wording required

clauses.finding: Default places/loaders and options are merged, checked and retained in explorer closure with two caches. Caller, filesystem, configured loader and transform boundaries are real.
Search starts from the requested/default directory, checks cache and searchPlaces, processes stopping directory itself, then stops at stopDir/root or walks upward. No match reaches transform(null).

Only access failure is caught and skipped. readFile at line 199 is outside that catch. package.json counts as a found config only when packageProp extraction is non-null; empty ordinary files obey ignoreEmptySearchPlaces.

Explicit load validates filepath, uses absolute key and its own cache, chooses/validates loader by extension then reads. Empty ordinary files return isEmpty results without invoking content loader under either ignoreEmptySearchPlaces value.

Search/load call transform and cache its return value; search also backfills visited directories. Cache hits and separate/all clearing are real. Transform returns may be promises because cache insertion does not await transform.
Parse/loader/transform failures propagate, and read failures propagate in both search and load. access-check failures are the search skip case; normal miss is distinct.
The selected async explorer is lines 157-309; sync implementation starts at 311, import/require interoperability is 55-78. Evidence/views/cards are deliverable policy, not a source behavior.
